Spread and rest

Spread expands iterable elements or own enumerable object properties. Rest collects
remaining values or properties.

Interview question: Does object spread perform a deep copy?
Answer: No. It copies own enumerable properties shallowly.
Practice: Merge two objects with an overlapping key and check which wins.
